subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should OpenClaw make owner-qualified `skills install --force` fail when the existing tracked skill has the same slug but a different owner?
rationale: The patch prevents silent installed-skill replacement and aligns install with update/verify, but it changes the meaning of `--force` for workflows that intentionally used cross-owner replacement.

options.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
options.body: Merge the PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

options.title: Require explicit override path
options.body: Ask for a deliberate owner-change override if maintainers want cross-owner replacement to remain possible without silent clobbering.

options.title: Preserve current force behavior
options.body: Reject this guard and keep `--force` as unconditional same-slug replacement, accepting the installed-state clobber risk.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md names Shadow as a ClawHub owner, and this decision is ClawHub force-install policy rather than a mechanical code repair.
